## Mental Health
```{r}

mentalHealth <- fread("~/Desktop/GRIT/Kibera/subsetCsv/mentalHealth.csv", header = TRUE)
labelled_data <- readRDS("~/Desktop/GRIT/Kibera/codebook/codebook_labelled_data.rds")
```

```{r}
# make var numeric
numericVars <- c("x1.1", "x1.2", "x1.3", "x2.1", "x3.1_1_TEXT", "x3.9" )
for (col in numericVars) {
  mentalHealth[[col]] <- as.numeric(as.character(mentalHealth[[col]]))
}

# make var date
mentalHealth$x1.4 <- as.Date(mentalHealth$x1.4, format = "%d/%m/%Y")

# make var string
charVars <- c("x2.5_5_TEXT" , "x2.7_6_TEXT", "x2.10_8_TEXT", "x2.12_10_TEXT", "x2.14_5_TEXT", "x2.16_7_TEXT", "x2.21_9_TEXT", "x3.3_7_TEXT", "x3.13_8_TEXT", 
              "x3.14_7_TEXT", "x3.17_7_TEXT", "x4.10_1_TEXT", "x7.9_6_TEXT") 

for (col in charVars) {
  mentalHealth[[col]] <- as.character(mentalHealth[[col]])
}


#for (col in factorVars) {
  #data[[col]] <- as.factor(data[[col]])
#}


allVars <- names(mentalHealth)
excludeVars <- c(numericVars, charVars, "x1.4")
factorVars <- setdiff(allVars, excludeVars)


for (col in factorVars) {
  mentalHealth[[col]] <- as.character(mentalHealth[[col]])
}
```

```{r}
# Get overlapping variables
common_vars <- intersect(names(mentalHealth), names(labelled_data))

print(common_vars)

# Identify non-numeric variables
non_numeric_vars <- common_vars[
  sapply(common_vars, function(var) {
    !is.numeric(mentalHealth[[var]]) && !is.numeric(labelled_data[[var]])
  })
]

# Apply labels to non-numeric overlapping variables only
for (var in non_numeric_vars) {
  var_label(mentalHealth[[var]]) <- var_label(labelled_data[[var]])
  val_labels(mentalHealth[[var]]) <- val_labels(labelled_data[[var]])
}

unique(mentalHealth[["x2.2"]])

```

```{r}
mentalHealth$x2.2_factor <- to_factor(mentalHealth$x2.2, levels = "label")

sql_result <- sqldf("
  SELECT
    [x2.2_factor],
    [PHQ9Level],
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM mentalHealth
  GROUP BY [x2.2_factor], [PHQ9Level]
  ORDER BY [x2.2_factor], [PHQ9Level]
")

# Step 2: Pivot to make a wide table (Age as rows, dv as columns)
pivot_table <- sql_result %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = PHQ9Level,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = list(count = 0)
  )

pivot_table_totals <- pivot_table %>%
  adorn_totals(where = c("row", "col"), na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 3: View the table
print(pivot_table_totals)
```



## Gender Perceptions
```{r}
gender <- fread("~/Desktop/GRIT/Kibera/subsetCsv/genderPerceptions.csv", header = TRUE)
labelled_data <- readRDS("~/Desktop/GRIT/Kibera/codebook/codebook_labelled_data.rds")
```

```{r}
# make var numeric
numericVars <- c("x1.1", "x1.2", "x1.3", "x2.1", "x3.1_1_TEXT", "x3.9" )
for (col in numericVars) {
  gender[[col]] <- as.numeric(as.character(gender[[col]]))
}

# make var date
gender$x1.4 <- as.Date(gender$x1.4, format = "%d/%m/%Y")

# make var string
charVars <- c("x2.5_5_TEXT" , "x2.7_6_TEXT", "x2.10_8_TEXT", "x2.12_10_TEXT", "x2.14_5_TEXT", "x2.16_7_TEXT", "x2.21_9_TEXT", "x3.3_7_TEXT", "x3.13_8_TEXT", 
              "x3.14_7_TEXT", "x3.17_7_TEXT", "x4.10_1_TEXT", "x7.9_6_TEXT") 

for (col in charVars) {
  gender[[col]] <- as.character(gender[[col]])
}


#for (col in factorVars) {
  #data[[col]] <- as.factor(data[[col]])
#}


allVars <- names(gender)
excludeVars <- c(numericVars, charVars, "x1.4")
factorVars <- setdiff(allVars, excludeVars)


for (col in factorVars) {
  gender[[col]] <- as.character(gender[[col]])
}
```

```{r}
# Get overlapping variables
common_vars <- intersect(names(gender), names(labelled_data))

print(common_vars)

# Identify non-numeric variables
non_numeric_vars <- common_vars[
  sapply(common_vars, function(var) {
    !is.numeric(gender[[var]]) && !is.numeric(labelled_data[[var]])
  })
]

# Apply labels to non-numeric overlapping variables only
for (var in non_numeric_vars) {
  var_label(gender[[var]]) <- var_label(labelled_data[[var]])
  val_labels(gender[[var]]) <- val_labels(labelled_data[[var]])
}

unique(gender[["x2.2"]])

```


```{r}
gender$x8.1_factor <- to_factor(gender$x8.1, levels = "label")
gender$x8.2_factor <- to_factor(gender$x8.2, levels = "label")
gender$x8.3_factor <- to_factor(gender$x8.3, levels = "label")
gender$x8.4_factor <- to_factor(gender$x8.4, levels = "label")
gender$x8.5_factor <- to_factor(gender$x8.5, levels = "label")
gender$x8.6_factor <- to_factor(gender$x8.6, levels = "label")
gender$x8.7_factor <- to_factor(gender$x8.7, levels = "label")
gender$x8.8_factor <- to_factor(gender$x8.8, levels = "label")
gender$x8.9_factor <- to_factor(gender$x8.9, levels = "label")
gender$x2.2_factor <- to_factor(mentalHealth$x2.2, levels = "label")
```

```{r}
sql_result <- sqldf("
  SELECT
    [x2.2_factor],
    [x8.1_factor],
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM gender
  GROUP BY [x2.2_factor], [x8.1_factor]
  ORDER BY [x2.2_factor], [x8.1_factor]
")

# Step 2: Pivot to make a wide table (Age as rows, Gender as columns)
pivot_table <- sql_result %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = x8.1_factor,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = list(count = 0)
  )

pivot_table_totals <- pivot_table %>%
  adorn_totals(where = c("row", "col"), na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 3: View the table
print(pivot_table_totals)
```


```{r}

#}


allVars <- names(sexual)
excludeVars <- c(numericVars, charVars, "x1.4")
factorVars <- setdiff(allVars, excludeVars)


for (col in factorVars) {
  sexual[[col]] <- as.character(sexual[[col]])
}
```

```{r}
# Get overlapping variables
common_vars <- intersect(names(sexual), names(labelled_data))

print(common_vars)

# Identify non-numeric variables
non_numeric_vars <- common_vars[
  sapply(common_vars, function(var) {
    !is.numeric(sexual[[var]]) && !is.numeric(labelled_data[[var]])
  })
]

# Apply labels to non-numeric overlapping variables only
for (var in non_numeric_vars) {
  var_label(sexual[[var]]) <- var_label(labelled_data[[var]])
  val_labels(sexual[[var]]) <- val_labels(labelled_data[[var]])
}

unique(sexual[["x2.2"]])
unique(sexual[["x3.10"]])

```

```{r}
sexual$x3.8_factor <- to_factor(sexual$x3.8, levels = "label")
sexual$x3.10_factor <- to_factor(sexual$x3.10, levels = "label")
sexual$x3.11_factor <- to_factor(sexual$x3.11, levels = "label")
sexual$x3.12_factor <- to_factor(sexual$x3.12, levels = "label")
sexual$x3.13_factor <- to_factor(sexual$x3.13, levels = "label")
sexual$x3.14_factor <- to_factor(sexual$x3.14, levels = "label")
sexual$x3.18_factor <- to_factor(sexual$x3.18, levels = "label")
sexual$x3.19_factor <- to_factor(sexual$x3.19, levels = "label")
sexual$x3.20_factor <- to_factor(sexual$x3.20, levels = "label")

sexual$x2.2_factor <- to_factor(sexual$x2.2, levels = "label")
```


```{r}
sql_result <- sqldf("
  SELECT
    [x2.2_factor],
    [x3.8_factor],
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM sexual
  GROUP BY [x2.2_factor], [x3.8_factor]
  ORDER BY [x2.2_factor], [x3.8_factor]
")

# Step 2: Pivot to make a wide table (Age as rows, Gender as columns)
pivot_table <- sql_result %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = x3.8_factor,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = list(count = 0)
  )

pivot_table_totals <- pivot_table %>%
  adorn_totals(where = c("row", "col"), na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 3: View the table
print(pivot_table_totals)
```

## Subset domestic violence and mental health together

When you did not want them to, has someone ever... x mental health
```{r}
sql_result <- sqldf("
  SELECT
    m.[PHQ9Level],
    d.[x6.2_factor],
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM dv AS d
    JOIN mentalHealth AS m
    ON d.[x1.2] = m.[x1.2]
  GROUP BY m.[PHQ9Level], d.[x6.2_factor]
  ORDER BY m.[PHQ9Level], d.[x6.2_factor]
")

# Step 2: Pivot to make a wide table (Age as rows, Gender as columns)
pivot_table <- sql_result %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = x6.2_factor,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = list(count = 0)
  )

pivot_table_totals <- pivot_table %>%
  adorn_totals(where = c("row", "col"), na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 3: View the table
print(pivot_table_totals)
```
